age_limit.details: The age limit for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 31 July 2026.

qualification.details: Degree/Diploma candidates should possess a full-time regular four-year Degree in Engineering or a full-time regular three-year Diploma in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-recognised institution. Candidates must have secured minimum 50% marks in aggregate. For SC/ST candidates, the minimum required marks are 45%. Candidates who have passed Degree/Diploma on or after 01 April 2022 are eligible to apply. Candidates who have completed more than five years from the date of passing the qualifying examination as on the joining date will not be eligible. Candidates appearing in the final year examination and awaiting results may also apply, subject to fulfilling the required qualification at the time of joining.

salary_details.details: Selected apprentices under AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly stipend during the one-year apprenticeship training period.

selection_process: The selection process for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the percentage of marks obtained by candidates in their qualifying examination.

Police verification certificate from the local area of residence.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview/document verification through their registered email ID only.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal. Candidates must complete registration on the NATS portal before applying for apprenticeship training under Airports Authority of India, Western Region.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: AAI has announced Graduate and Diploma Apprentice positions in various disciplines including Finance, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication, Information Technology, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and Human Resources. The number of vacancies mentioned in the notification is tentative and may be reduced or increased according to organisational requirements.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are required to register themselves on the NATS 2.0 portal before applying for AAI apprenticeship training. Only applications received through the NATS portal will be considered.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The recruitment is open for Degree and Diploma holders in various disciplines. Candidates must be domiciles of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh or the Union Territory of Diu and should reside near the respective airport locations listed under Airports Authority of India Western Region.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualification requirement differs according to the Graduate Apprentice and Diploma Apprentice discipline.

rows.educational_qualification: Degree in Commerce (B.Com) or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration (BBA).
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution.
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Electronic Communication or Tele Communication.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.
Degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering from a statutory university or recognised institution.
Degree in any stream with knowledge of computer and administrative work.
Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering from a recognised institution.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification Conditions
content_sections.text: Degree/Diploma candidates should possess a full-time regular four-year Degree in Engineering or a full-time regular three-year Diploma in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-recognised institution. Candidates must have secured minimum 50% marks in aggregate. For SC/ST candidates, the minimum required marks are 45%. Candidates who have passed Degree/Diploma on or after 01 April 2022 are eligible to apply. Candidates who have completed more than five years from the date of passing the qualifying examination as on the joining date will not be eligible. Candidates appearing in the final year examination and awaiting results may also apply, subject to fulfilling the required qualification at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 31 July 2026 .

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices under AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly stipend during the one-year apprenticeship training period.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the percentage of marks obtained by candidates in their qualifying examination. Shortlisting of candidates based on percentage of marks in the qualifying examination. Interview and verification of certificates/testimonials. Submission of Certificate of Medical Fitness from a Gazetted Government Medical Officer or Medical Officer of a Government Undertaking at the time of joining. Police verification certificate from the local area of residence. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview/document verification through their registered email ID only.

content_sections.heading: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Apprentices must undergo training at the notified airports/establishments. Requests for change in training location will not be accepted. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship, terminated apprenticeship midway, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship with another organisation or AAI at the same qualification level are not eligible. Candidates having one year or more training/job experience after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible for apprenticeship. AAI will not provide any regular employment guarantee after completion of apprenticeship training.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal. Candidates must complete registration on the NATS portal before applying for apprenticeship training under Airports Authority of India, Western Region.

faq.question: Q1. What is AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is an apprenticeship recruitment drive conducted by Airports Authority of India, Western Region, Mumbai for engagement of Graduate and Diploma Apprentices under the Apprentices Act.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification provides discipline-wise apprentice posts. The number of vacancies 36 is tentative and may increase or decrease according to organisational requirements.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are available under AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Graduate Apprentice and Diploma Apprentice positions in Finance, Electrical, Civil, Electronics & Telecommunication, Information Technology, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and HR disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have the required Degree or Diploma qualification in the relevant discipline. Engineering candidates require a full-time regular Degree/Diploma from a recognised institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 26 years as on 31 July 2026. Age relaxation is available for SC/ST and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices will receive ₹15,000 per month and Diploma Apprentices will receive ₹12,000 per month during the one-year apprenticeship training period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application through the NATS portal is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the NATS 2.0 portal after completing student registration and profile verification.
